question: Identify the titles and IDs of the top 6 articles submitted by EPTCS discussing massive photon pair production at colliders.
semantic_text: Massive photon pairs production at hadron colliders
source_sql:
SELECT a.title, a.id
FROM articles a
JOIN submitters s ON a.submitter_id = s.id
WHERE a.abstract_embedding MATCH lembed('all-MiniLM-L6-v2', "Massive photon pairs production at hadron colliders") AND s.name = 'EPTCS'
AND a.k = 6;

FROM articles a
